schoolName: Mili Institute of Higher Education Faculty of Medicine
reviewNotes: HOLD — Mili Institute of Higher Education (MIHE) has current first-party operational evidence: its official home page, crawled in July 2026, announces Kankor 1405 admission for MD; its Faculty of Curative Medicine page dated January 2026 describes six years of theoretical/practical study plus one year of practical work; and its current fee page lists AFN 80,000 per semester for Medicine plus an AFN 5,500 admission fee. The Institute also claims an international-student office and nearly 180 foreign students across Medicine and Stomatology. These first-party claims establish a candidate for research, not a publishable study-abroad offer. No independent current programme accreditation/recognition, authoritative foreign admissions procedure, instruction-language confirmation, named clinical training agreements, reliable international accommodation/support package, or audience-relevant licensing pathway was verified. Given the unusually high importance of operational continuity and student support in this context, no commercial page should be published.

sources.label: Mili Institute of Higher Education — official home page
sources.notes: Current official page announces Kankor 1405 admission for MD, DMD, law and pharmacy, providing direct operational evidence of an active intake.

sources.label: MIHE — Curative Medicine faculty overview
sources.notes: January 2026 official faculty page describes six years of theoretical/practical study plus one year practical work, reported student numbers, laboratory facilities and faculty departments. These are institutional claims, not independently audited evidence.

sources.label: MIHE — fee structure
sources.notes: Lists AFN 5,500 admission fee and AFN 80,000 Medicine semester fee. The page says it serves local and foreign students but does not provide a full foreign-admissions process or total cost of attendance.

sources.label: MIHE — international-student overview
sources.notes: Claims an international-student office and nearly 180 foreign students in Medicine and Stomatology. It does not document accommodation, immigration processing, insurance, emergency procedures or a current support entitlement.

sources.label: Afghanistan Ministry of Higher Education — registered private universities and institutes
sources.notes: Government registry lists Meli Institute of Higher Education. The registry copy is older and does not replace current programme-level approval or external accreditation evidence.

missingForPublication: Current independent programme accreditation and professional-recognition evidence
Authoritative foreign-applicant, visa and document-recognition procedure
Named clinical sites and current clinical-placement terms
Verified international accommodation, insurance, safeguarding and continuity-support evidence
structuredFacts.notes: Current operations and published institutional fees are verified from MIHE's own active website. They are insufficient to overcome the absent independent programme and international-student assurance evidence required by the publish gate.

draftContent.notes: All public-facing narrative is intentionally blank. A commercial medical page would require strong, current third-party assurance on recognition, delivery continuity, clinical learning and international student protection; that evidence was not established.
